notes.title: Bug Fixes Patch
notes.notes:
Fixes Intermediate Level 5, where the level would sometimes switch to another level.
Fixes Impossible Level 1, which sometimes does not unlock further levels.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
There are now 10 new achievements:
- 3 achievements for beating the 5th level of every difficulty
- 3 achievements for beating the 30th level of every difficulty
- 4 achievements for beating each of the 4 impossible levels

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
- First 5 levels have indicators for every letter.  This will help new players understand the letter positioning better.

- All levels, with 6 or more letters, now have an indicator every 5 letters.

- The "Exit" button now goes to the level select screen instead of the main menu

- Fixes in the instructions (the last page would sometimes bug out for some users)
